# API reference (1.0.0-draft)

Base path `/api/v1`. The contract is [`schemas/api/openapi.yaml`](../../schemas/api/openapi.yaml); this page is
rendered from it. Operations marked *designed* are in the contract but not implemented yet (they return 404).
Errors are `application/problem+json`. Out-of-scope objects return 404, never 403 (no enumeration).

## ASVS

| Operation | Request | Permission | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listAsvsRequirementStatus` *(designed)* | `GET /applications/{appId}/asvs` | `application.read` |  |

## Administration

| Operation | Request | Permission | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `adminListOrgUnits` | `GET /admin/org-units` | `org.admin` | The organization tree with member and application counts |
| `adminCreateOrgUnit` | `POST /admin/org-units` | `org.admin` | The parent must be exactly one level above (config/organization.yaml). Re-parenting is not offered. |
| `adminUpdateOrgUnit` | `PATCH /admin/org-units/{slug}` | `org.admin` |  |
| `adminListMembers` | `GET /admin/org-units/{slug}/members` | `org.admin` |  |
| `adminRemoveMember` | `DELETE /admin/org-units/{slug}/members/{userId}` | `org.admin` |  |
| `adminAddMember` | `PUT /admin/org-units/{slug}/members/{userId}` | `org.admin` |  |
| `adminListGrants` | `GET /admin/role-assignments` | `org.admin` |  |
| `adminGrantRole` | `POST /admin/role-assignments` | `org.admin` | Never to yourself (403, audited); platform_admin comes from the identity provider only; scoped roles need an org unit, organization-wide roles take none. |
| `adminRevokeRole` | `DELETE /admin/role-assignments/{grantId}` | `org.admin` |  |
| `adminListUsers` | `GET /admin/users` | `org.admin` |  |

## Applications

| Operation | Request | Permission | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listApplications` | `GET /applications` | `application.read` | List applications in the caller's scope |
| `registerApplication` | `POST /applications` | `application.register` | Register an application from its repository contract (.security/application.yaml) |
| `getApplication` | `GET /applications/{appId}` | `application.read` |  |
| `updateApplicationSettings` *(designed)* | `PATCH /applications/{appId}` | `application.settings.write` | Update platform-owned settings (fields owned by application.yaml are read-only here) |
| `getClassification` | `GET /applications/{appId}/classification` | `application.read` | Current classification with inputs, matched rules and explanation |
| `decideClassification` | `POST /applications/{appId}/classification/decisions` | `classification.decide` | Approve or reject the pending classification (Tier 1/2) |
| `requestTierOverride` *(designed)* | `POST /applications/{appId}/classification/override-requests` | `classification.request` | Request a tier different from the computed tier (downgrades need AppSec approval) |
| `listApplicationEnvironments` *(designed)* | `GET /applications/{appId}/environments` | `application.read` |  |
| `listApplicationRepositories` | `GET /applications/{appId}/repositories` | `application.read` |  |
